raw_text:
ELEANOR R. VANCE
VICE PRESIDENT OF GLOBAL OPERATIONS & SUPPLY CHAIN
Chicago, IL  |  +1 (312) 555-8492  |  e.vance.executive@example.com  |  linkedin.com/in/eleanor-vance-dummy
EXECUTIVE PROFILE
Accomplished Operations Executive with 16+ years of enterprise leadership managing $250M+ P&L operations across North America, EMEA, and APAC. Recognized for orchestrating large-scale operational transformations, post-merger integrations, Lean Six Sigma deployment, and end-to-end logistics modernization. Trusted advisor to Board of Directors with proven ability to scale global operating margins while delivering superior customer satisfaction.
CORE EXECUTIVE COMPETENCIES
• Multi-Site P&L Management ($250M+)
• Global Supply Chain Optimization
• Post-Merger Operational Integration
• Lean Six Sigma / Continuous Improvement
• Strategic Procurement & Vendor Negotiation
• Cross-Functional Executive Leadership
• Enterprise Risk Management & Compliance
• ERP Systems Modernization (SAP S/4HANA)
• Boardroom Governance & Stakeholder Relations
EXECUTIVE EXPERIENCE
Vice President of Global Operations  —  Crestview Manufacturing & Logistics Group
2020 – Present  |  Chicago, IL
Oversee operating strategy and continuous performance across 18 manufacturing facilities and 1,200+ personnel worldwide, maintaining direct oversight of a $320M operational budget.
Instituted standardized Lean manufacturing methodologies that yielded a $28.4M operating cost reduction within 24 months without head-count reduction.
Led cross-border logistics restructuring through the COVID-19 and post-pandemic disruptions, cutting order fulfillment cycle times from 19 days to 11 days.
Presented quarterly strategic updates, operational KPIs, and risk evaluations directly to the Executive Committee and Board of Directors.
Director of Supply Chain & Manufacturing  —  Apex Industrial Technologies
2015 – 2020  |  Detroit, MI
Spearheaded enterprise-wide rollout of SAP S/4HANA migration across 6 distribution hubs, completed 2 months ahead of schedule and 8% under budget.
Renegotiated key Tier-1 carrier contracts delivering $9.6M in recurring freight savings over a 3-year agreement cycle.
Achieved OSHA voluntary protection status across all sites, improving team safety records by 64%.
EDUCATION & CREDENTIALS
Master of Business Administration (MBA)  •  The University of Chicago Booth School of Business (2013)
Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering  •  Purdue University (2007)
Credentials: Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt (CSSMBB)  •  APICS Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
